plans.idea: Centered vertical story: logo crowns the column, a wide text block gives the headline and bullet list room to breathe, the book cover sits as the visual centrepiece, and a wide centred CTA button anchors the bottom, so the eye runs brand → message → product → action.
Product-led stack: small logo on top, then a large book cover as the hook, with the headline and benefits grouped directly above a centred CTA so the copy and the button read as one action block.

Left-aligned editorial column like the original: logo, headline, bullets and CTA button all share one left edge in the top half, and the book cover is set large and flush right at the bottom as a counterweight.
